_comment: FINAL-LONG-WATER-04. Runtime-only local bank palette, split from terrain_playground.json because that broad file fingerprints the terrain and vegetation bakes. This rectangle covers river-course stations 4-6 and stops west of Old Mill Crossing; the shader additionally requires real rock texture weight, so meadow tops and water remain untouched. R3's dark earth multipliers crushed the bank into a near-black mass at night, so the same height-aware strata now use higher-reflectance earth, moss and silt values at slightly lower strength. This preserves visible material intervals under the production night without emission or an injected light. All values are tunable after fresh capture; strength 0 restores the underlying terrain material.
